3.2.3 Timing events related to bus communication
[TPS_TIMEX_0021] Purpose of TDEventCom ⌈The element TDEventCom and its
specializations are used to describe the occurrences of an event which are observed
at a speciﬁc location in the System view, in particular any event related to communica-
tions. ⌋(RS_TIMEX_0001)
Events related to communication can be used during the speciﬁcation of:
• SystemTiming 2.3
• EcuTiming 2.6
